findings.highlight: I’ll have to come up with some plan
findings.evidenceJa: 勝機を探し出しておかなければ絶対に後悔する
findings.governingReading: unless I find some chance of victory beforehand, I will surely regret it
findings.explanation: Shirou’s standard is finding a real opening, and the certain regret driving him disappears.

findings.highlight: thinking until the very last minute
findings.evidenceJa: ギリギリまであがく事
findings.governingReading: struggling desperately until the last possible moment
findings.explanation: Active, undignified resistance becomes quiet thought.

findings.evidenceJa: みっともなくもなんともない
findings.governingReading: is not shameful in the least
findings.explanation: Shirou’s rejection of pride and appearances disappears.

findings.highlight: More importantly, she’s in a panic
findings.evidenceJa: くわえて、ひどく慌てている
findings.governingReading: On top of that, she is terribly flustered
findings.explanation: An additive observation becomes a hierarchy of importance.

findings.evidenceJa: 気になったものは仕方がない

findings.explanation: Rin invites Shirou into the room; the English prematurely instructs him to sit.

findings.highlight: I’m going to give you a plan
findings.evidenceJa: こっちから行こうと思ってた
findings.governingReading: I was going to come to you myself
findings.explanation: Rin’s intended movement toward Shirou becomes a promise to supply a plan.

findings.highlight: since you can’t come up with any
findings.evidenceJa: ギルガメッシュをどうこうするかって事なら
findings.governingReading: if this is about what to do concerning Gilgamesh
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents Rin insulting Shirou for failing to devise a plan.

findings.highlight: locks the door, and walks to the back of the room
findings.evidenceJa: がちゃん、と鍵をかけて、ずかずかと奥に戻る
findings.governingReading: locks the door with a click and strides heavily back into the room
findings.explanation: The audible lock and Rin’s forceful, irritated gait disappear.

findings.highlight: even though she’s the one with the plan
findings.evidenceJa: そっちから来るつもりだった、なんて言っておきながら
findings.governingReading: even though she claimed she had intended to come to me
findings.explanation: The narration repeats the movement claim; mirror moon instead repeats its invented claim that Rin has a plan.

findings.highlight: used his riches to collect all the magic-resistant equipment in the world
findings.evidenceJa: 金にあかせて対魔術の武装を纏ってる
findings.governingReading: uses his wealth to outfit himself with anti-Magecraft armaments
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents exhaustive worldwide collection and weakens the fact that Gilgamesh is equipped with the armaments.
